title: Necromancer: new undead
description: New undead for the Necromancer mod, made with Meshy: a Lich (a robed sorcerer that casts bolts, on the game's skeleton mage) and a Bone Golem (a 4 m brute of fused bones, on the game's heavy skeleton knight). Raise them with the Necromancer's wheel or /necromancer raise lich | golem.
notes: The sources are not in the repository: the Meshy glbs and textures, the fitted glbs, the game dumps; the paths below point to a local folder. Build: python -I tools/models/make_mod.py tools/models/packs/necromancer_undead.json
The GUIDs are fixed forever: mods/necromancer/minions.lua and players' saves refer to them.

Lich: Meshy preview 01a17d27-93bc-71d6-9384-47273a6382b8, refine 01a17d29-80c9-7359-9b8b-8f5b481bce0a; fitted with blender/fit_humanoid.py --keep-uvs onto char_enemy_skeleton_mage_01 (skeleton 5a4d9d98); a copy of Enemy_Skeleton_Mage01 with DamageMod_Multiplier x1.3 (health x1.5 comes from Necromancer at runtime).

Bone Golem: Meshy preview 01a17d4a-d5ab-73b2-8fde-5eda7bccb1b4, refine 01a17d4c-6e3e-743a-bd7a-a2aae07fc22a; fitted with blender/fit_humanoid.py --keep-uvs --material 1 --height-scale 0.92 onto char_enemy_skeleton_elite_02 (skeleton 6d3d9870, body material 1; the measured top is the helmet's plume); a copy of Enemy_Skeleton_Heavy_Hero (health x2 comes from Necromancer at runtime; not a boss: the heavy cyclops skeleton's templates are all bosses, and 9 m tall).
